question: Select the most appropriate opton to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is "**although**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Although** is a **conjunction** which means "**in spite of the fact**".
 
• It has a **tone of surprise**.
 
 
• **Example**: ***Although** it was bright and sunny, we played on the beach.* 
 
 
 
• Therefore, the appropriate option is "although". 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Despite** - without any affect from the object mentioned. 

 
 
• **Example**: *He was slim **despite** being a foodie. *
 
 
 
• **Even though** - means the same as "Although". But it has a **stronger tone** than "although".
 
 
• **Example:** ***Even though** I waited in the queue for an hour, I was unable to get the ticket*.
 
 
 
• **In spite** - regardless.
 
 
• **Example:** ***In spite** of my warning, she did not study for the test*.
